verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents a dedicated Structured Outputs feature that guarantees responses adhere to a developer-supplied JSON Schema. The changelog lists structured outputs as a flagship model capability, so the core of the story is delivered directly. Missing for 10: evidence of natively typed SDK helpers (e.g. schema-to-class parsing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of schema adherence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get typed, structured outputs — JSON-schema-constrained responses or a natively typed answer format — so my code consumes model output without fragile parsing

citations.quote: Structured Outputs is a feature that ensures the model will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema
GPT-5.5 supports a 1M token context window, image input, structured outputs, function calling
